The dataset will be unlinked from the Power BI dataset but the dataset on the Power BI end will not be affected.
Upon publishing the dataset again a new dataset will be created on Power BI.

The dataset will be unlinked from the Power BI dataset and the dataset on the Power BI will get deleted with all its tables and data in it.
Upon publishing the dataset again a new dataset will be created on Power BI.

The eventhouse will be unlinked from the Power BI eventhouse but the eventhouse on the Power BI end will not be affected.
Upon publishing the eventhouse again a new eventhouse will be created on Power BI.

The eventhouse will be unlinked from the Power BI eventhouse and the eventhouse on the Power BI will get deleted with all its content.
Upon publishing the eventhouse again a new eventhouse will be created on Power BI.

The table will be unlinked from the Power BI table but the table on the Power BI end will not be affected.
Upon publishing the table again a Same table will be updated on Power BI.

The table will be unlinked from the Power BI table and the table on the Power BI will get deleted with all its content.
Upon publishing the table again a new table will be created on Power BI.

The database will be unlinked from the Power BI database and the database on the Power BI will get deleted with all its content.
Upon publishing the database again a new database will be created on Power BI.
